title: Compile ordered noncommuting words into inverse-Jordan kernels
statement: The source's Lemma 7.1 maps a rational Hermitian polynomial with a supplied positive uniform gap g to constant rational Hermitian residues. A suffix graph preserves ordered products, a finite edge penalty yields a uniform inverse-Jordan kernel gap, and a strict negative witness transfers at the same baselines/reference sizes.

provides: constant rational residues of inverse-Jordan kernels
assumptions: alpha I <= A_j <= (1-alpha) I on the actual domain
positive gap; mere nonnegativity is not covered
costs: Nw <= 1 + sum of supported word lengths
finite rational construction; no efficiency or witness-acquisition theorem
contract.units: dimensionless matrix quadratic forms; source-local Jordan convention
contract.obstruction: Linearizing a noncommutative polynomial without losing word order or witness dimension; whole hardness reduction remains unaudited.

evidence.quote: Suffix closure preserves the declared noncommutative

review.scope: Exact source-supported extraction only; any scoped substantive acceptance is a separate version-bound review overlay.
